summary: Click to place the selected tower, spending currency through the game manager.
overview: Click a point in the scene to place the currently selected tower prefab, paying for it from the shared wallet. Wire a shop button's OnClick to SelectTowerToPlace to choose what the next click places.
useCases: A tower shop where the player picks then places.
Restricting placement to buildable ground via the mask.
Spending currency as part of placing, in one step.

params.tuning: Layers a click can land on. This is what stops towers being placed on the path or on each other.
Defaults to Camera.main, which breaks quietly in a scene with more than one camera.

gotchas.title: Nothing is selected until the shop selects it
gotchas.body: Before the first SelectTowerToPlace call, clicks do nothing. That is correct, and looks broken when testing without the shop UI.

gotchas.title: It does not check the click is over UI
gotchas.body: Clicking a shop button can also place a tower behind it. Gate it on EventSystem.current.IsPointerOverGameObject.
